name: date_add_and_date_diff
query: SELECT DISTINCT date_add(2016-02-28, 1) AS leap_day, date_add(2015-02-28, 1) AS march_first, date_add(2016-03-01, -1) AS back_to_leap_day, date_add(2016-12-31, 1) AS new_year, date_add(2016-01-31, 0) AS same, date_diff(2016-03-01, 2016-02-01) AS february, date_diff(2015-03-01, 2015-02-01) AS short_february, date_diff(2016-01-01, 2016-12-31) AS negative WHERE account = 'Expenses:Financial:Fees'
notes: date_add(date, days) adds days (negative days go back); date_diff(a, b) is the days from b to a.
